notes.detailedSummary: A no-Bertini restriction argument bounds h0 on a possibly nonreduced Cartier hyperplane using a regular positive-twist section, Serre vanishing and the Euler polynomial, then obtains actual L=A+D without finite generation. Genuine addition and normal section division are combined with homogeneous approximation and ample normalized compactness. The divided FS net is not asserted decreasing; its divisorial limits identify an actual A-psh quotient. Homogeneous Legendre decomposition and ample EP extend the identity to the entire genuine dominated cone, including every point of the fixed pole set. The inverse is an intrinsic actual extension and a divisorial homeomorphism, preserving order, suprema and decreasing limits. No energy equation for unrestricted minimal singularities is claimed in this note.
notes.text:
Retain every algebraically closed trivially valued characteristic-zero field k, of arbitrary cardinality, and every smooth integral projective original X of dimension n>=1. The line bundle L is an actual big rational bundle. The following are mathematical deductions relative to the exact task-granted actual-ample P16.1 theorem G0, used only on an actual ample rational A. No incomplete102 endpoint or construction106/107 is assumed.

Every such L admits actual Kodaira data L=A+D on the original X, with A ample, D effective rational Cartier, and an actual rational-bundle isomorphism. Here is the proof without Bertini or finite generation. Clear B=rL to an integral big bundle and choose a very ample bundle M with a nonzero section defining a Cartier hyperplane scheme H. On possibly nonreduced H, choose a sufficiently positive very ample T so that T-B|H is globally generated. Finitely many associated points impose finitely many proper k-linear vanishing subspaces; infinite k permits a section outside their union. The associated-prime zero-divisor criterion makes that section regular, so multiplication by its mth power injects B^m|H into T^m. Serre vanishing and the Euler-polynomial degree bound give h0(H,B^m|H)=O(m^(n-1)). Bigness, in its usual positive section-volume definition, gives h0(X,mB)>=c m^n for infinitely many arbitrarily large m. The restriction sequence therefore yields a nonzero section of mB-H. Its effective Cartier divisor D' gives actual data A=M/(mr), D=D'/(mr). No hypothesis on the section ring, cardinality, target measure or support enters. The exact primary inputs are Stacks 01Q3(7), 0B5T(4), 0BEM, 00LD, 10.63.5 and 00L0; the omitted reduction in 0B3Q is supplied by the zero-divisor argument.

Fix any such datum before specifying a target. Put sigma=log|s_D| in the canonical trivial metric, Z=|D|^an and U=X^an minus Z. Sigma is at most zero, finite on U, minus infinity on Z and zero at the generic trivial valuation. Every function-field divisorial valuation lies in U. Define P_D(L) geometrically as all genuine BJ L-psh u satisfying u<=sigma+C for some finite C. Then P_D(L)=F_D(PSH(A)), where F_D(psi)=sigma+psi at every analytic point, including Z. Genuine section multiplication and BJ 4.7 prove the forward membership of this image. Equality or inequality between images can be subtracted divisorially, then BJ 4.22--4.23 extend it to all points. Thus F_D is injective and reflects order.

To prove surjectivity without the faulty divided-net inference, first take homogeneous h in PSH(A+D) with h<=sigma. D=0 is immediate. Otherwise BJ 6.17 gives decreasing homogeneous FS h_i in actual varying rational L_i with c1(L_i) tending to A+D and sup h_i=0. The compact level set K={sigma=-1} has, for each positive rational epsilon<1, an empty-set tail of the closed sets {h_i>=-1+epsilon}. Use valid pairs (i,epsilon) beyond that tail, ordered by increasing i and decreasing epsilon; they form a directed cofinal refinement. Set t_i=1-epsilon, tending to one. Homogeneity proves h_i<=t_i sigma at divisorial points with sigma<0; sup h_i=0 handles sigma=0. Divisorial domination extends the bound everywhere. Normal actual section division, BJ 2.23, produces homogeneous FS quotients r_i=h_i-t_i sigma in L_i-t_i D, with actual extensions across Z. Their classes tend to A. Do not assert that r_i decreases. Choose rational c_i>1 tending to one with c_i A-c1(L_i-t_iD) ample; openness of the ample cone permits this. Addition of its zero potential and scaling put r_i/c_i in normalized genuine PSH(A). G0 compactness yields an actual convergent subnet limit r. At every divisorial v its value is h(v)-sigma(v), so genuine F_D(r)=h everywhere by determination.

For arbitrary u<=sigma+C, let M=sup u. BJ 6.24 gives genuine homogeneous h_lambda, lambda<M, with h_lambda+lambda<=u and u=sup_lambda(h_lambda+lambda) pointwise. Evaluating at a v and scaling v by a>0 gives a h_lambda(v)<=a sigma(v)+C-lambda; letting a tend to infinity and applying domination gives h_lambda<=sigma everywhere. The preceding division gives homogeneous r_lambda in PSH(A) with sup zero. Their shifts r_lambda+lambda are uniformly bounded above by M. Ample EP supplies r=sup* of these shifts, while BJ 5.6 preserves their divisorial supremum values. Consequently F_D(r)=u divisorially and hence everywhere. Conversely every genuine A-psh potential is bounded above, so its image is dominated by sigma plus a constant. This proves the entire genuine dominated cone identity, not merely a section-generated subcone.

The inverse Q_D is subtraction on U followed by this unique genuine A-psh extension. Values over Z are not selected arbitrarily and no two infinite values are subtracted. Divisorial coordinates differ by the fixed finite sigma(v), proving that both maps are continuous in the divisorial topology. The generic maximum principle gives sup u=sup Q_Du. Hence sigma is the maximal normalized member of this relative cone. If u_i decreases to a genuine u, order reflection, decreasing closure and divisorial determination give Q_Du_i decreasing to Q_Du at every point. These facts provide the actual quotient needed in n2.

Published BJ2206.07183v2 Theorem A already gives full smooth numerical EP; Corollaries 2.1--2.2 already give V_L and normalized compactness for all pseudoeffective classes, and Corollary 2.3 states Siu division. Those foundations are not claimed new or missing. The older printed BJ6.21 divided-net monotonicity inference is replaced above. The exact finite illustration sigma=-1, h=(-4/5,-9/10), t=(7/10,17/20) satisfies both h_i<=t_i sigma bounds, while divided values (-1/10,-1/20) increase. This only diagnoses the inference; the proof uses genuine compactness.

notes.detailedSummary: Using n1, the signed local norm identity is h_L=h_A+log|f|; multiplication by the actual divisor section identifies metrized bundles on the complement. BE 7.14 (semiample, including trivial fields), continuous cycle products and the granted genuine ample limits define a local metric product before any target. Reference truncations sigma+max(Q_Du,-j), strict-winning locality and zero pluripolar mass identify the increasing nonpluripolar extension with the actual ample product, proving mass A^n without asserting class volume. Energy is first a quotient-difference integral against those actual relative mixed products and then its decreasing extension. The target condition is mass A^n and finite sup(E_D(u)-integral Q_Du dmu), equivalent to integrability of all actual quotients; mu(Z)=0 follows intrinsically. notes.text:
Use n1 for the full geometric cone, actual all-point quotient and its order/homeomorphism/decreasing identities. Retain the same arbitrary-cardinality algebraically closed trivial characteristic-zero k, smooth integral projective original X, and actual data L=A+D fixed before a measure. The exact actual-ample grant G0 supplies genuine ample raw energy and mixed products on A, decreasing and quotient-weighted continuity, EP/compactness, comparison/domination, every continuous two-sided outer derivative, finite-dual-energy integrability, relative J estimates, target L1 continuity, attained equations and uniqueness. It is never applied to nonample L. Set V=A^n>0, sigma=log|s_D|, Z=|D|^an and U=X^an minus Z.

First construct the genuine local L-metric product, before choosing a target. Clear rational powers. With s_D=f e_D, local frames e_A, e_L=e_A tensor e_D, and norm convention ||e||_psi=exp(-psi)||e||_triv, the actual raw weights satisfy h_L=h_A+log|f|. Indeed sigma=log|f|+log||e_D||_triv and u=sigma+psi; subtracting the two canonical frame logarithms leaves precisely that plus sign. In frame e_A tensor s_D the weight is h_A. On U, f is an analytic unit and dd^c log|f|=0. CLD1204.6277v2 18.1.2/18.1.6 and 8.8.5 give the curvature convention and harmonic-addition invariance. Thus these are actual metrized-bundle and local product identities on the original carrier.

For continuous genuine A metrics, BE1805.01016v3 7.14 applies to actual semiample bundles, including trivial fields, and gives decreasing smooth semipositive regularization. A continuous limit on compact X gives uniform convergence. BE8.3--8.5 give genuine original-cycle products and their unique uniform-to-weak extension; BE8.18 and BJ7.23 identify the continuous product with the genuine ample energy operator. Therefore the continuous local L product on U equals the restriction of product(A+dd^c psi_i). BE7.8 is not used: it assumes nontrivial valuation. No global continuous regularization on nonnef L is asserted.

For bounded genuine quotients, decreasing continuous genuine ample approximants transport to decreasing original L metrics on U. Each compactly supported continuous test on U extends by zero to a continuous test on compact X. G0 decreasing product continuity therefore defines their local weak product, independently of the genuine approximants, as the restriction of the unique ample mixed product. This proves frame independence and ordinary open-set locality within the retained metric family. It constructs the singular local extension from genuine metric products, not from an inverse target. The raw cycle coefficients at ample model stages are b_E times the intersection of the restricted model classes, with b_E=ord_E(model central fiber); those coefficients and the original fundamental cycle are retained.

These ample finite-energy outputs charge no pluripolar Borel sets: BJ4.36 makes proper algebraic closed sets pluripolar, BJ5.3 makes pluripolar sets negligible, and BJ13.2 excludes negligible mass for finite-dual-energy measures under ample EP. Output finite dual energy is part of G0. For mixed products, the average psi_bar=(psi_1+...+psi_n)/n is genuine finite energy and positive multilinearity gives M(psi_1,...,psi_n)<=n^n/n! times MA_raw,A(psi_bar). Hence mixed products also give zero pluripolar mass, in particular zero mass on Z. No inverse equation is used for this exclusion.

For u=F_D psi use actual reference truncations psi_j=max(psi,-j) and u_j=sigma+psi_j=max(u,sigma-j). A constant floor max(u,-j) is not used in the nonnef class. Let B_j=U intersect {psi>-j}, and let nu_j be the zero extension of the bounded local top product of u_j restricted to B_j. For k>=j, psi_j=max(psi_k,-j); genuine strict-winning locality at the bounded stages identifies the two products on B_j. Thus nu_j increases and has mass at most V. The increasing limit is Radon: inner regularity follows by approximation from a finite stage and compact subsets; bounded mass supplies finite regularity. Interlacing levels tending to infinity proves floor-level independence. This is the actual reference-relative nonpluripolar top product, defined before any target.

At a finite-energy endpoint psi, locality also gives nu_j=1_Bj MA_raw,A(psi). The output integrates psi and therefore does not charge its minus-infinity set, and it does not charge Z. The B_j exhaust full measure, proving that the increasing nonpluripolar limit equals MA_raw,A(psi) and has raw mass V. Mixed products follow from the same bounded local products and polarization: M(psi_1,...,psi_n)=1/n! times the sum over nonempty S of (-1)^(n-|S|)|S|^n MA_raw,A(average of psi_i for i in S). Inclusion--exclusion cancels all monomials omitting a factor and leaves the n! fully mixed term. Every average is genuine finite energy, so the local nonpluripolar polarization equals the positive genuine mixed measure. Consequently M_D(u_1,...,u_n)=product(A+dd^c Q_Du_i) is a proved geometric identity on original X, with mass A^n. It is not an asserted class-volume mass.

For bounded quotients define energy intrinsically by the actual relative integral E_D(u)=1/(n+1) sum_{j=0}^n integral Q_Du against M_D(u repeated j times, sigma repeated n-j times). On U the integrand is the actual difference u-sigma; its unique quotient extension handles every pole point without infinite subtraction. The proved mixed-product identity gives E_D(u)=E_raw,A(Q_Du), with E_D(sigma)=0. Extend by decreasing reference truncations u_j. G0 energy continuity proves the same identity for every genuine u. Thus E1_D={u in P_D:E_D(u)>-infinity}=F_D(E1(A)) consists of actual original-carrier functions. Raw translation is E_D(u+c)=E_D(u)+Vc. Increasingness, concavity, weak upper semicontinuity and genuine decreasing continuity follow with the all-point quotient identities of n1.

For genuine unbounded decreasing nets u_ij to finite-energy u_i, their actual quotients decrease at every point. G0 pairing continuity gives weak mixed convergence first on real PL tests, then on all continuous tests using uniform density and the fixed masses V. For an integrable genuine psh quotient test psi_0 and decreasing approximants psi_0j, the weighted measures psi_0j M_D(u_1j,...,u_nj) converge weakly to psi_0 M_D(u_1,...,u_n). Their total integral is the test-containing signed pairing minus the zero-test pairing. Decreasing pairing continuity gives convergence of totals; after translating tests below zero, the positive lsc weighted-measure argument identifies all limiting weighted measures. Differences of tests are handled term by term. These are quotient-relative weighted limits. Absolute integrability of sigma or u is not inferred.

The normalized relative cone is compact because it is homeomorphic, with preserved suprema, to normalized genuine PSH(A). Relative obstacles are actual sigma+b, b continuous on original X. The inequality F_D chi<=sigma+b implies chi<=b on U and hence divisorially; BJ4.22 extends it everywhere. The converse is immediate. Thus P_D(sigma+b)=F_D P_A(b). The same argument with the usc obstacle psi+tf gives P_D(u+tf)=F_D P_A(psi+tf) for every original continuous f and every real t. Relative outer energy is the infimum of envelope energies over relative continuous majorants sigma+b; their inequalities are equivalent to genuine quotient majorant inequalities for these obstacles. It therefore equals the raw ample outer energy at psi+tf. The uniform real-PL estimate is E_D_down(u+tf)=E_D(u)+t integral f M_D(u^n)+O_f(t^2), including negative t by replacing f by -f. For arbitrary continuous f, uniform PL approximants with error epsilon give the energy error V|t|epsilon. Dividing with each sign, then letting epsilon go to zero, proves both derivatives, equal to integral f M_D(u^n). No direction is restricted to a pullback or skeleton.

For u=F_D psi and v=F_D chi, strict winning sets off Z agree with the quotient winning sets. On Z both images are minus infinity and every relevant product has zero mass. Since max(u,v)=F_D max(psi,chi), genuine ample locality and comparison give the actual relative inequality integral_{u<v} M_D(v^n)<=integral_{u<v} M_D(u^n), and genuine mixed locality on ordinary opens. Almost-everywhere domination transfers off Z to the quotients; ample domination then yields it at every original point. The relative I functional is V^-1 integral (Q_Du-Q_Dv)(M_D(v^n)-M_D(u^n)), well defined almost everywhere by quotient integrability. It equals the ample I, hence is nonnegative and vanishes only when the actual quotients differ by one real constant. Equal relative measures therefore imply actual equality modulo constants, including at every pole point.

The intrinsic target condition is precisely positive Radon mu of mass V with D_D(mu)=sup_{u in E1_D}(E_D(u)-integral Q_Du dmu)<infinity. The onto actual quotient identity gives D_D(mu)=E_raw,A_dual(mu)=V E_A_dual(mu/V). G0 integrability characterizes finiteness by integrability of every actual quotient. BJ13.2 then implies mu(Z)=0; imposing it separately would be redundant, not an admissible-support restriction. All measures satisfying this condition are included.

Here is actual attainment, not completion. Normalize a genuine maximizing sequence by sup u_i=0. With d=E_A_dual(mu/V), relative J_D=sup Q_Du-E_D(u)/V and J_mu=d-E_D(u)/V+integral Q_Du d(mu/V), G0 strict concavity gives J_D<=C_n(J_mu+d). Thus J_D is eventually bounded. Original relative compactness gives a subnet with an actual genuine limit u=F_D psi. Lower semicontinuity of J makes it finite energy. G0 target L1 continuity on bounded-J sets gives convergence of quotient integrals; energy upper semicontinuity gives attainment of the dual supremum at this actual u.

For every real t the actual envelope P_A(psi+tf) lies between psi plus or minus |t| ||f|| and is genuine finite energy. Its relative image retains the reference. Its objective and the obstacle inequality imply E_D_down(u+tf)-integral(psi+tf)dmu<=E_D(u)-integral psi dmu. Divide by positive t and use the derivative to get integral f M_D(u^n)<=integral f dmu. Divide by negative t for the reverse inequality. Equality on every continuous test identifies the previously constructed genuine measure with mu. Equal measures yield uniqueness as above. Conversely an actual finite-energy output has finite dual energy by G0 ample energy concavity after the proved product identity. Necessity and sufficiency therefore match exactly.

notes.text:
Retain smooth integral projective original X of positive dimension over every algebraically closed trivially valued characteristic-zero field. This note reconstructs its assertions independently of the incomplete102 blowup endpoint and its historical notes.

The extra zero-volume equation proved is exactly the actual trivial rational bundle O_X. Published BJ1801.08229v4 Corollary4.24 gives PSH(0)=R on connected X. Its proof normalizes phi<=0 with generic value zero and takes the decreasing genuine zero-class sequence m phi. Its limit is genuine, since its generic value is zero; finiteness at each divisorial valuation forces phi(v)=0, then divisorial determination gives phi=0 everywhere. Translations give precisely the finite constants. With reference zero, the actual raw energy is zero and the actual finite-energy space is R. Constant local metric weights have zero curvature, and the genuine positive-dimensional top product is zero, consistent with BE7.14/8.5 on actual semiample O_X and its raw intersection mass zero. A positive Radon target of that mass can only be zero. Its intrinsic dual supremum is sup_c(0-integral c times 0)=0, attained by every constant, with uniqueness modulo constants. Normalized compactness is a singleton; continuous-obstacle envelopes are infimum constants; outer energy and both derivatives in every original continuous direction are zero; comparison and locality are immediate. No division by a zero mass occurs. Dimension zero instead has empty top product mass one and energy E(c)=c, and is not this zero-volume case.

First diagnostic: let X=Bl_p P2, H=pi*O(1), E exceptional and L_a=H+aE for rational a>0. H^2=1, H.E=0 and E^2=-1, the latter from the exceptional normal bundle O_E(-1). Thus L_a^2=1-a^2 and L_a.E=-a. For divisible m, restriction of mH+jE to E is O_E(-j), which has no sections for every j>0. Successive restriction sequences give h0(X,mL_a)=h0(X,mH)=binom(m+2,2). To justify the second equality directly, the two blowup coordinate rings over the affine plane are k[x,y/x] and k[y,x/y]; their intersection in the Laurent fraction ring is k[x,y], by comparing monomial exponents. Away from p the map is an isomorphism, so pi_*O_X=O_P2 and actual O(m) trivializations give the equality of sections. Therefore vol(L_a)=1. At a=1 the square is zero; at a=2 it is -3. Both are positive-volume nonnef examples, not zero-volume examples.

Second diagnostic: on P1 x P1 let L=p1*O(1). It is actual semiample, h0(X,mL)=m+1, and both volume and square are zero. The pulled coordinates s0,s1 generate L and have maximum canonical norm one. For real b>0 the genuine continuous normalized FS potential u_b=max(log|s0|,log|s1|+b)-b has generic value zero. At t ord_{s1=0} its value is max(0,b-t)-b, which is negative for t>0 and equals -b for t>=b. Thus u_b and zero are not equal modulo constants. BE1805.01016v3 Theorem7.14 applies to this actual semiample bundle including the trivial field, and Proposition8.5 constructs its genuine positive continuous top measure of raw mass L^2=0. Every such measure is zero. This is genuine zero-volume noninjectivity and obstructs transferring ample top-operator uniqueness unchanged to all zero-volume classes. It does not contradict the trivial-bundle theorem, whose whole cone consists of constants. No broader zero-volume finite-energy equation is claimed.

The finite diagnostic program checks only exact arithmetic: a=1 gives square0 and a=2 square-3, while the proved section formula gives volume1; the displayed FS values distinguish normalized zero-volume potentials. These finite observations do not prove the geometric or analytic claims. The independent proofs and literal primary statements are retained in P16.5-paper.md/PDF and external-premises.json. notes.text:
Combining the backward-supported proofs n1, n2 and n3 gives a complete draft theorem for the exact task-permitted full big alternative of original P16.5. Retain every algebraically closed trivially valued characteristic-zero k, every smooth integral projective original X of dimension n>=1, every actual big rational L, and every chosen actual Kodaira datum L=A+D with A ample and D effective rational Cartier, fixed before the target. A positive Radon target admits an actual finite-energy solution exactly when its mass is A^n and sup_{u in E1_D}(E_D(u)-integral Q_Du dmu)<infinity; equivalently all actual finite-energy quotients are integrable. This is not just an ample equation with a changed label: n1 realizes every geometric datum and the whole genuine dominated cone, repairing division and retaining all pole-point values; n2 proves the correctly signed actual frame identity, constructs the local metric products and nonpluripolar extension before any target, defines actual integral energy and proves every variational gate on original X.
